review_locator: PMCID:PMC4618768, Control of autoimmune CNS inflammation by astrocytes; PMCID:PMC11717358, Exploring neuroglial signaling: diversity of molecules implicated in microglia-to-astrocyte neuroimmune communication
primary_title: The cell-specific induction of CXC chemokine ligand 9 mediated by IFN-gamma in microglia of the central nervous system is determined by the myeloid transcription factor PU.1
decision_basis: The reviews identify IFN-gamma-dependent differential induction of CXCL9 and CXCL10 in CNS glia; the cited primary shows IFN-gamma induces Cxcl9 mRNA in primary microglia, with STAT1 dependence and promoter occupancy in the microglial context.
limitations_preserved: Microglia-restricted productive output in the cited primary; preserve STAT1/PU.1/IRF8 promoter context and distinguish CXCL9 gene induction from protein release and later CXCR3 binding. No astrocyte CXCL9 claim, SCI transfer, or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4618768, Control of autoimmune CNS inflammation by astrocytes; PMCID:PMC11717358, Exploring neuroglial signaling: diversity of molecules implicated in microglia-to-astrocyte neuroimmune communication
primary_title: The cell-specific induction of CXC chemokine ligand 9 mediated by IFN-gamma in microglia of the central nervous system is determined by the myeloid transcription factor PU.1
decision_basis: The reviews identify IFN-gamma as a dominant CNS-glial CXCR3-ligand stimulus; the cited primary detects significant CXCL9 protein release from primary microglia after IFN-gamma treatment, but not from astrocytes.
limitations_preserved: Microglial extracellular CXCL9 output only; preserve the cell-specific restriction, distinguish released protein from Cxcl9 transcription and later CXCR3 signaling, and do not infer traumatic-SCI weighting or terminal-TF output.
